content: From Table TABREF39 we observe that in the variable number generation setting, greedy search outperforms beam search consistently. This may because beam search tends to generate short and similar sequences. We can also see the resulting F INLINEFORM0 @ INLINEFORM1 scores are generally lower than results reported in previous subsections, this suggests an over-generation decoding strategy may still benefit from achieving higher recall.
